digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI/CD workflows
propositions: External integration suite exercises only one live provider at a time (Anthropic by default), leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetectable by CI automation until manual local testing.

Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows with one arm per credentialed provider (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), each arm skipping loudly when credentials are absent rather than silently passing.

Provider override must use REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to config files setting only [llm.model_classes], deep-merging over discovered config, to dogfood the documented developer workflow and avoid fallback to deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL.

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials to a scoped IAM role, not EC2 instance-role IMDS, and must set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION explicitly to avoid NoRegionError.

Ambient default model cfg.model falls back to literal claude-opus-4-8 (Anthropic) when not overridden, causing non-Anthropic arms to call Anthropic unintentionally when tests reference cfg.model instead of named model classes, violating the goal of removing ambient defaults.
